title.narrative: 2005 Convention: skills development for diverse cultural expressions in Egypt

description.narrative: This workplan supports implementation of the UNESCO 2005 Convention by strengthening skills development for diverse cultural expressions in Egypt, particularly among youth, women, and underrepresented cultural communities. Through creative industry training, digital skills, entrepreneurship support, and cultural education initiatives, the programme aims to enhance employability, innovation, cultural participation, and sustainable cultural ecosystems.
